title: Global Oral Drugs Market is Predicted to Surpass USD 1 Trillion Mark by 2034 | DelveInsight
author: Delveinsight
description: The global oral drugs market is experiencing steady growth driven by increasing chronic disease prevalence and patient preference for convenient treatment options. The market is projected to grow from USD 1 trillion in 2025 to USD 1.6 trillion by 2034 at a ~6% CAGR. North America leads with 36% market share, while Asia-Pacific is expected to register the fastest growth. Key drivers include advancements in drug delivery technologies, expansion of oral therapies across oncology and other therapeutic areas, and rising pharmaceutical R&D investments.

title: Not Lilly. Not Johnson & Johnson. This Stock Will Be the Biggest Healthcare Winner of 2026
author: Prosper Junior Bakiny
description: Moderna has surged over 600% in 2026, driven by breakthrough Phase 3 trial results for its personalized cancer vaccine (intismeran autogene) combined with Merck's Keytruda, plus FDA approval for its flu vaccine mFLUSIVA. However, despite strong innovation, the stock appears overvalued at a $90 billion market cap with a 45% downside according to Wall Street analysts. The company would need to generate unrealistic revenue levels to justify current valuations, leaving little room for error.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While the company achieved significant clinical breakthroughs with its cancer vaccine and flu vaccine approval, the stock is considered overvalued at current levels with 45% downside risk according to Wall Street. The business fundamentals are strong, but the share price has risen too much relative to realistic profit projections.

Merck's Keytruda showed improved efficacy when combined with Moderna's personalized cancer vaccine in Phase 3 trials, representing a significant clinical win and potential revenue opportunity through the partnership.

title: Can BMY Navigate Generic Challenges Across Its Key Drug Portfolio?
author: Na
description: Bristol Myers Squibb's legacy drug portfolio declined 5% in H1 2026 due to generic competition, though Eliquis showed strong 19% growth. The company raised 2026 revenue guidance but faces significant headwinds in 2027 with expected Eliquis sales decline of $1.5-$2 billion and upcoming generic competition in 2028. BMY must rely on its Growth Portfolio to offset legacy product pressures.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While Eliquis showed strong growth, the legacy portfolio faces significant generic competition headwinds. Expected $1.5-$2 billion Eliquis sales decline in 2027 and upcoming generic competition in 2028 pose substantial near-term and long-term challenges to revenue sustainability.

title: Forget COVID: Moderna Is Turning Into a Cancer Company -- and Wall Street Is Taking Notice
author: Adria Cimino
description: Moderna is transitioning from a COVID-19 vaccine company to an oncology-focused biotech firm. The company announced positive phase 3 results for its personalized cancer vaccine (intismeran autogene) paired with Merck's Keytruda for melanoma treatment. With the global oncology market projected to grow from $253 billion to over $700 billion by 2034, Moderna's stock has surged over 600% this year, though it now trades 61% above Wall Street's average price target of $123.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company is successfully pivoting to high-growth oncology market with positive phase 3 trial results, strong stock performance (+600% YTD), and entry into Nasdaq-100. However, personalized vaccine approach may result in slower revenue ramp-up and higher manufacturing costs.
Strategic partnership with Moderna on promising cancer vaccine candidate (Keytruda combination) that showed positive phase 3 results, positioning the company in the high-growth oncology market.

title: Surrozen Announces Closing of Second Tranche of March 2025 Private Placement for $95.1 Million
author: Na
description: Surrozen, Inc. (NASDAQ: SRZN) announced the closing of its second tranche of a private placement, raising approximately $95.1 million in gross proceeds. The closing was triggered by FDA clearance of the IND application for SZN-8141 on October 2, 2026. The company now has cash runway into 2029 to advance its ophthalmology pipeline, including the DUET Phase 1b/2a study of SZN-8141 for diabetic macular edema and initial clinical development of SZN-8143. First patient dosing in the DUET study is expected in Q4 2026, with initial data anticipated in H2 2027.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company successfully closed a significant $95.1M financing round, achieved FDA clearance for its lead candidate's IND application, and secured cash runway through 2029. These milestones strengthen the balance sheet and enable advancement of multiple clinical programs, representing substantial progress in drug development and financial stability.

Merck is mentioned only as a reference point for competitive validation, noting that its remigromig (FZD4 agonist) achieved primary endpoints in a Phase 2b/3 trial in DME. This provides supportive evidence for Surrozen's approach but does not directly impact Merck's business or represent company-specific news.
